title: Dead Labrador Nelly photographed as a ball of light after a Cape Canaveral launch trip
place_text: Cape Canaveral, Florida; Fayetteville, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And she comes up out of her grave in a little ball of light. and I took that picture and that's how I got that.

plain: In 2007, after a trip to see a launch at Cape Canaveral, Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says UFOs appear around him, says he photographed his dead Labrador, Nelly, rising from her grave as a ball of light: "she comes up out of her grave in a little ball of light, and I took that picture." He tells Michels this himself and also tells it in his book UFO of God, in a story where a man named Timothy Taylor also appears.
